_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Member 1 of 11 in the bookkeeping-purchase-order-3way chain. Declares the eight registers (PurchaseOrder, PurchaseOrderLine, GoodsReceiptNote, GoodsReceiptLine, SupplierInvoice, ThreeWayMatch, ToleranceProfile, VendorPerformance) the whole 3-way-match feature rests on. PurchaseOrder, GoodsReceiptNote, SupplierInvoice and ThreeWayMatch carry x-openregister-lifecycle state machines (ADR-031). Money fields use integer-cent arithmetic (ADR-022): unitPrice, lineTotal, vatAmount, totalExclVat, totalVat, totalInclVat. Tax rates use basis points (1/10000). Every order, line, receipt, invoice and match record carries costCenter + projectCode for dimensional reporting. No imperative code — downstream chain members (02-11) own the controllers, services and guards. Slugs are concise to stay inside the 30-character magic-table cap (longest = SupplierInvoice → oc_openregister_shillinq_supplierinvoice).

PurchaseOrder.title: Purchase Order
PurchaseOrder.description: Purchase order issued to a supplier. Lifecycle draft → approved → sent → partial_received → fully_received → invoiced → closed, with cancelled terminal state. Approval chain is operator-driven; Peppol metadata is populated by the transmission engine in member 03. cost_center + project_code propagate to lines, receipts, invoices and matches for dimensional reporting.

poNumber.description: Auto-generated CBS-conform purchase-order number, unique per administration.
poNumber.title: PO Number

supplierId.description: FK to the Vendor (supplier) the order is issued to.
supplierId.title: Supplier ID

supplierReference.description: Supplier's own reference for the order (optional, populated on acknowledgement).
supplierReference.title: Supplier Reference

requester.description: User ID of the requester who raised the order.
requester.title: Requester

requisitionId.description: FK to the Requisition (purchase-requisition change) this order was materialised from, when it was created via requisition conversion rather than directly. Blank for orders created by the pre-existing direct-create flow. When app config `require_approved_requisition_for_po` is enabled, PurchaseOrderService requires this to reference an approved/converted Requisition.
requisitionId.title: Requisition ID

costCenter.description: Dimensional cost-centre tag propagated to all lines, GRNs, invoices and matches that descend from this PO.
costCenter.title: Cost Center

projectCode.description: Dimensional project tag propagated to all lines, GRNs, invoices and matches that descend from this PO.
projectCode.title: Project Code

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (EUR for NL administrations).
currency.title: Currency

paymentTerms.description: Free-form payment terms description (e.g. '30 days net').
paymentTerms.title: Payment Terms

deliveryAddress.description: Delivery address text, single string for declarative simplicity.
deliveryAddress.example: Conduction B.V., Nieuwe Donk 3, 4879 AC Etten-Leur, NL
deliveryAddress.title: Delivery Address

expectedDeliveryDate.description: Expected delivery date for the order overall (lines may carry their own dates).
expectedDeliveryDate.title: Expected Delivery Date

totalExclVat.description: Order total excluding VAT in euro cents (sum of PurchaseOrderLine.lineTotal). Integer cents per ADR-022 money rule.
totalExclVat.title: Total Excl VAT

totalVat.description: Order VAT total in euro cents (sum of PurchaseOrderLine.vatAmount). Integer cents.
totalVat.title: Total VAT

totalInclVat.description: Order total including VAT in euro cents (totalExclVat + totalVat). Integer cents.
totalInclVat.title: Total Incl VAT

approvalChain.description: Ordered list of approvers traversed for this order. Operator-driven; downstream members 02 wire the routing.

userId.description: User ID of the approver in the chain.
userId.title: User ID

approvalChain.title: Approval Chain

peppolSentAt.description: Timestamp the order was successfully transmitted to the supplier via Peppol (populated by member 03).
peppolSentAt.title: Peppol Sent At

peppolMessageId.description: Peppol message identifier returned by the access point.
peppolMessageId.title: Peppol Message ID

peppolFallbackReason.description: If Peppol transmission failed and a manual fallback (email/portal) was used, this records the reason.
peppolFallbackReason.title: Peppol Fallback Reason

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this order belongs to; reads are scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Order is editable; not yet submitted for approval.

approved.label: Goedgekeurd
approved.description: Approval chain complete; order may now be sent.

sent.label: Verzonden
sent.description: Order transmitted to supplier (Peppol or fallback).

partial_received.label: Deels ontvangen
partial_received.description: Some but not all line quantities have been receipted via GRN.

fully_received.label: Volledig ontvangen
fully_received.description: All line quantities have been receipted (within tolerance).

invoiced.label: Gefactureerd
invoiced.description: Supplier invoice has been matched and approved against this order.

closed.label: Afgesloten
closed.description: Order is closed; no further activity expected.

PurchaseOrderLine.title: Purchase Order Line
PurchaseOrderLine.description: Line item on a PurchaseOrder. Money fields are integer cents per ADR-022; unitPrice is also integer cents to keep arithmetic exact across quantity × price → lineTotal. VAT rate is stored in basis points (1/10000). cost_center + project_code inherit from the parent order and may be overridden per line for granular dimensional reporting.

lineNumber.description: 1-based line number within the parent order.
lineNumber.title: Line Number

productOrServiceCode.description: Product or service catalogue code (FK to Product when known).
productOrServiceCode.title: Product Or Service Code

description.description: Free-text line description (always populated even when productOrServiceCode is set).
description.title: Description

quantityOrdered.description: Ordered quantity in the declared unitOfMeasure. Three-decimal precision supports per-unit and per-litre measures.
quantityOrdered.title: Quantity Ordered

unitOfMeasure.description: UN/ECE Recommendation 20 unit code (e.g. EA, KGM, LTR, HUR).
unitOfMeasure.title: Unit Of Measure

unitPrice.description: Unit price in euro cents (integer per ADR-022). Net of VAT.
unitPrice.title: Unit Price

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (inherits from order when null).
currency.title: Currency

lineTotal.description: Computed lineTotal in euro cents: round(quantityOrdered × unitPrice). Integer cents.
lineTotal.title: Line Total

vatRate.description: VAT rate in basis points (1/10000). 2100 = 21%; 900 = 9%; 0 = exempt/zero.
vatRate.title: VAT Rate

vatAmount.description: VAT amount in euro cents: round(lineTotal × vatRate / 10000). Integer cents.
vatAmount.title: VAT Amount

expectedDeliveryDate.description: Line-level expected delivery date (overrides order-level when set).
expectedDeliveryDate.title: Expected Delivery Date

glAccount.description: RGS general-ledger account code for this line (drives auto-coding at invoice match).
glAccount.title: GL Account

toleranceOverride.description: FK to a ToleranceProfile that overrides the default/supplier/category profile for this line.
toleranceOverride.title: Tolerance Override

costCenter.description: Dimensional cost-centre tag (inherits from parent PO when null).
costCenter.title: Cost Center

projectCode.description: Dimensional project tag (inherits from parent PO when null).
projectCode.title: Project Code

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this line belongs to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

GoodsReceiptNote.title: Goods Receipt Note
GoodsReceiptNote.description: Goods Receipt Note (GRN) recording physical receipt of goods against one or more purchase orders. Multi-PO receipt is allowed (po_ids is an array). Lifecycle draft → received → quality_checked → accepted → rejected. Photos and temperatureLog support cold-chain quality evidence. cost_center + project_code propagate from the originating PO(s).

poIds.description: FK references to PurchaseOrder records this GRN receipts against (multi-PO supported).
poIds.title: PO Ids

receivedAt.description: Timestamp the goods were received at the delivery location.
receivedAt.title: Received At

receivedBy.description: User ID of the receiver who signed for the goods.
receivedBy.title: Received By

temperatureLog.description: Cold-chain temperature readings during transit (Celsius, ISO timestamp).

recordedAt.title: Recorded At
recordedAt.description: The date and time for recorded at.

temperatureC.title: Temperature C
temperatureC.description: The numeric value for temperature c.

temperatureLog.title: Temperature Log

qualityCheckPassed.description: Whether the post-receipt quality check passed.
qualityCheckPassed.title: Quality Check Passed

costCenter.description: Dimensional cost-centre tag inherited from the originating PO(s).
costCenter.title: Cost Center

projectCode.description: Dimensional project tag inherited from the originating PO(s).
projectCode.title: Project Code

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this GRN belongs to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Receipt is being captured; not yet finalised.

received.label: Ontvangen
received.description: Physical goods receipted; awaiting quality check.

quality_checked.label: Kwaliteitscontrole
quality_checked.description: Quality inspection complete; awaiting accept/reject decision.

accepted.label: Geaccepteerd
accepted.description: Goods accepted; PO line quantities updated.

rejected.label: Afgekeurd
rejected.description: Goods rejected; lines flagged for supplier return (terminal).

GoodsReceiptLine.title: Goods Receipt Line
GoodsReceiptLine.description: Per-PO-line breakdown of a GoodsReceiptNote. Captures the quantities received, accepted and rejected against each PurchaseOrderLine plus the inspector identity and batch reference for traceability.

poLineId.description: FK to the PurchaseOrderLine this receipt line settles against.
poLineId.title: PO Line ID

inspector.description: User ID of the quality inspector.
inspector.title: Inspector

batchReference.description: Batch/lot reference for the received units (traceability).
batchReference.title: Batch Reference

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this receipt line belongs to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

SupplierInvoice.title: Supplier Invoice
SupplierInvoice.description: Inbound supplier invoice. At slice-01 this is a read-only stub register: downstream members 05 (ingestion) and 06 (matching) own the population and lifecycle transitions. Lifecycle received → matching → matched → exception → approved → paid → rejected. UBL / OCR / Peppol metadata records the ingestion provenance. Money fields are integer euro cents per ADR-022; multipleOf 0.01 not used because cents are integers by construction.

supplierId.description: FK to the Vendor (supplier) that issued the invoice.
supplierId.title: Supplier ID

invoiceDate.description: Invoice date as stated on the document.
invoiceDate.title: Invoice Date

totalExclVat.description: Invoice total excluding VAT in euro cents (integer per ADR-022).
totalExclVat.title: Total Excl VAT

totalVat.description: Invoice VAT total in euro cents.
totalVat.title: Total VAT

totalInclVat.description: Invoice total including VAT in euro cents.
totalInclVat.title: Total Incl VAT

paymentReference.description: Payment reference (e.g. 16-digit Belastingdienst betalingskenmerk or supplier reference).
paymentReference.title: Payment Reference

ublSourceUri.description: URI of the UBL source document when the invoice was received as UBL.
ublSourceUri.title: Ubl Source URI

peppolReceivedAt.description: Timestamp the invoice was received via Peppol.
peppolReceivedAt.title: Peppol Received At

ocrConfidenceScore.description: OCR confidence score (0.00 - 1.00) when the invoice was ingested via OCR.
ocrConfidenceScore.title: Ocr Confidence Score

costCenter.description: Dimensional cost-centre tag inherited from the matched PO.
costCenter.title: Cost Center

projectCode.description: Dimensional project tag inherited from the matched PO.
projectCode.title: Project Code

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this invoice belongs to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

received.label: Ontvangen
received.description: Invoice ingested via UBL / Peppol / OCR; awaiting matching.

matching.label: In afstemming
matching.description: Matching engine actively comparing against PO + GRN.

matched.label: Gematched
matched.description: 3-way match successful within tolerance; awaiting approval.

exception.label: Uitzondering
exception.description: Match diverged beyond tolerance; routed to exception workflow.

ThreeWayMatch.title: 3-way Match
ThreeWayMatch.description: Result of a 3-way match between SupplierInvoice, PurchaseOrder(s), and GoodsReceiptNote(s). matchStatus enumerates auto-approval, within-tolerance success, the four exception types and a fraud alert. divergenceDetails capture per-field price / quantity / date deltas for the exception workflow in member 08.

invoiceId.description: FK to the SupplierInvoice being matched.
invoiceId.title: Invoice ID

matchedPoIds.description: FK references to PurchaseOrder records the invoice matched against.
matchedPoIds.title: Matched PO Ids

matchedGrnIds.description: FK references to GoodsReceiptNote records the invoice matched against.
matchedGrnIds.title: Matched Grn Ids

matchStatus.description: Match outcome. exception_* and fraud_alert route to the exception workflow.
matchStatus.title: Match Status

divergenceDetails.description: Per-field divergence breakdown (price, quantity, date) used by the exception workflow.

expected.description: Expected value from PO/GRN, serialised as string (monetary deltas in euro cents live in deltaCents; proportional deltas in deltaPercentage).
expected.title: Expected

actual.description: Actual value from invoice, serialised as string (monetary deltas in euro cents live in deltaCents; proportional deltas in deltaPercentage).
actual.title: Actual

deltaCents.description: Signed delta in euro cents for monetary fields.
deltaCents.title: Delta Cents

deltaPercentage.description: Signed delta in basis points (1/10000) for proportional comparisons.
deltaPercentage.title: Delta Percentage

divergenceDetails.title: Divergence Details

resolvedBy.description: User ID of the operator that resolved an exception match.
resolvedBy.title: Resolved By

resolutionAction.description: Action taken to resolve an exception match.
resolutionAction.title: Resolution Action

createdAt.description: Timestamp the match record was created.
createdAt.title: Created At

resolvedAt.description: Timestamp the match was resolved (when exception → resolved).
resolvedAt.title: Resolved At

costCenter.description: Dimensional cost-centre tag inherited from the matched PO.
costCenter.title: Cost Center

projectCode.description: Dimensional project tag inherited from the matched PO.
projectCode.title: Project Code

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this match belongs to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

auto_approved.label: Auto-approved
auto_approved.description: Exact 3-way match; no operator action needed.

within_tolerance.label: Binnen tolerantie
within_tolerance.description: Match diverged within tolerance; auto-approved with audit trail.

exception_missing_grn.label: GRN ontbreekt
exception_missing_grn.description: Invoice has no matching GRN (services or pre-receipt invoice).

exception_missing_po.label: PO ontbreekt
exception_missing_po.description: Invoice has no matching PO (off-contract spend).

fraud_alert.label: Fraudemelding
fraud_alert.description: Likely duplicate or fraudulent invoice; routed to security review.

ToleranceProfile.title: Tolerance Profile
ToleranceProfile.description: Config record defining the price / quantity / date tolerances a 3-way match must satisfy to auto-approve. Scope is global, per-supplier or per-category. Exception routing names a downstream queue. Status enum allows operators to retire old profiles without deleting historical references.

scope.description: Scope at which the tolerance applies.
scope.title: Scope

scopeReference.description: FK to the supplier or category when scope ≠ global.
scopeReference.title: Scope Reference

priceToleranceAmount.description: Absolute price-tolerance in euro cents (integer). Either of priceToleranceAmount or priceTolerancePercentage may be set.
priceToleranceAmount.title: Price Tolerance Amount

dateToleranceDays.description: Number of days an actual delivery date may diverge from the expected date.
dateToleranceDays.title: Date Tolerance Days

currencyRoundingTolerance.description: Absolute currency-rounding tolerance in euro cents.
currencyRoundingTolerance.title: Currency Rounding Tolerance

exceptionRouting.description: Routing tag for exceptions raised under this profile (e.g. 'ap-team', 'controller-approval').
exceptionRouting.title: Exception Routing

grIrClearingAccount.description: Optional per-profile override of the GR/IR clearing account code. When set, GRIRClearingService uses this account for both the GRN-accept clearing posting and the match-approval settlement instead of the administration-wide default. Leaving this empty falls back to app config gr_ir_clearing_account (default 2910).
grIrClearingAccount.title: Gr Ir Clearing Account

status.description: Profile lifecycle. Retired profiles remain historically referenced but no longer apply to new matches.
status.title: Status

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this profile belongs to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

VendorPerformance.title: Vendor Performance
VendorPerformance.description: Vendor performance scorecard per supplier per period. Rates are basis points (1/10000) so onTimeDeliveryRate of 9800 = 98.00 %. overallScore is a 0-10000 basis-point composite. score_trend reflects the period-over-period delta. automatedReviewEligible marks suppliers that may be auto-renewed without manual review. Populated by member 10.

supplierId.description: FK to the Vendor (supplier) the scorecard belongs to.
supplierId.title: Supplier ID

disputeCount.description: Number of disputes raised during the period.
disputeCount.title: Dispute Count

averageResolutionDays.description: Average resolution time for raised exceptions in days.
averageResolutionDays.title: Average Resolution Days

overallScore.description: Composite vendor score in basis points (1/10000). 0-10000.
overallScore.title: Overall Score

automatedReviewEligible.description: Whether the supplier may be auto-renewed without manual review.
automatedReviewEligible.title: Automated Review Eligible

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this scorecard belongs to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID
